page.layout: One column of running text, with marginal notes in the right margin. Running head at top centre, page number at top right. Catchword and gathering signature at the foot.

main_text.p: vestris, Esulae majoris & minoris, Ebu-li, Hermodactylus, Sambuci, Turpe-tum.
De Foliis.II. Folia sunt Temperata vel Intem-perata.
Intemperata vel sunt Calida, Frigida, Humida aut Sicca.

Folia Primo gradu Calida sunt: Folia Ca-lida.Absinthium, Althea, Borrago, Buglossa, Beta, Brasica, Chamomilla, Cuscutha, Eupatorium, Melilotus, Malabatrum, Linaria, Spicanardi, Scolopendrium, Symphytum, &c.

Secundo: Anethum, Angelica, Apium, Artemisia, Betonica, Chamæpytis, Hypericum, Hedera, Lupulus, Melissa, Marrubium, Myrrhis, Ocymum, Pimpinella, Peucedanum, Rosmarinus, Salvia, Scabiosa, Scordiu, Stœchas, Parthenium.
Tertio: Abrotanum, Anethum aridum, Asarum, Agnus castus, A-momum, Ammi, Baccharis, Dictam-num, Charyophyllata, Chamædrys, Carthamus, Centaurium, Chelido-

page.notes: Ornamental marks after "Anethum", "aridum", "Asarum", "Centaurium" and "Dictamnum" are printer's signs and are not transcribed. The first marginal note "flâ-tarū" is doubtful. Faint show-through text in the right margin and across the column (e.g. "Maiorana, Mentha, Menthastrum", "Thymus, Satureia", "Quarto: Allium", "Endivia, Cichorea") is from the other side of the leaf and is left out. The printed "Scordiu" and "Malabatrum" are kept as printed.
